output.title: Opt-in annotation copying option not set in this environment
output.content: The change adds the controller option --extra-certificate-annotations to copy specified annotation keys from Ingress or Gateway resources to Certificates. The environment's values keys do not include it and the manifests show no Ingress or Gateway resources, only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate. The option only takes effect when configured.
